name: Qatar Investment Authority
rationale: QIA co-invested alongside MGX, GIC and Coatue in Anthropic's $30B Series G round (post-money $380B); a Gulf-region SWF increasingly co-investing in the same AI-lab rounds as our tracked UAE sovereigns -- worth adding to the watchlist.

name: UK Sovereign AI Fund
rationale: UK's own AI-focused state investment vehicle co-invested with MGX, Alphabet/Google Ventures, Temasek and CapitalG in Isomorphic Labs' $2.1B Series B -- a newly visible sovereign vehicle appearing in AI-lab cap tables alongside tracked names.

name: Saudi National Infrastructure Fund (Infra)
rationale: Separate Saudi state vehicle (distinct from PIF) that structured the ~$1.2bn HUMAIN AI-data-center financing framework announced Jan 2026 in Davos; a second Saudi sovereign entity funding AI infra outside PIF proper that is not currently on the watchlist.
